verses.pali: “Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, viraddhaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati viraddhā.
verses.english: “Mendicants, those who have missed out on mindfulness of the body have missed out on freedom from death.

verses.pali: Amataṁ tesaṁ, bhikkhave, āraddhaṁ yesaṁ kāyagatāsati āraddhā”ti.
verses.english: Those who have undertaken mindfulness of the body have not missed out on freedom from death.”
